4.1.2.3 DET
The DET (Default Error Tracer) provides access to the DEM and RTE(SW-C) over
integrator specific code. The occurrence of a runtime error (signaled by calling
Det_ReportRuntimeError API) or transient fault (signaled by calling the
Det_ReportTransientFault API) triggers the execution of a corresponding error
handler which may be implemented as callout within the Det by an integrator of a
particular ECU and may only include the storage of the corresponding error event to
a memory, a call to the module Dem or the execution of short and reasonable
actions.
